note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). No deterministic ops file exists for this niche (page bands are research-driven fallbacks, not a fixed formula), so all gates are type=manual and require agent/render inspection.

GATE_1_safety_and_compliance.text: Risk tier (R4/R2/R1) correctly assigned in Phase 0 and consistently applied throughout
Disclaimer page present, tier-appropriate, neither overstates nor understates scope
No diagnostic language anywhere in the manuscript
No treatment claims anywhere in the manuscript
No guaranteed-outcome or timed-outcome language anywhere
No fabricated research, statistics, or case studies presented as real
All R4 exercises include the optional-exercise declaration
At R4: Crisis Resources appendix present with verified, active contacts
At R4: How to Use This Book includes safety guidance and non-linear reading permission
At R4 and R2: professional-referral language appears in each chapter contextually
No blame-framing directed at the reader

GATE_2_structure_and_completeness.text: Chapter count matches the approved TOC
Every chapter follows the five-part formula: scenario -> concept -> evidence -> exercises -> integration
No chapter opens with a generic warm-up; opening scenario is specific to that chapter's theme
Conclusion is approximately 1.5 formatted pages; not shorter, not extended into a new chapter
Conclusion introduces no new major concept or method
Front matter appears in correct order
Introduction begins on visible page 1 (Arabic numeral); no front-matter page numbers visible
All required appendices present and contain genuine reader value (no generic filler)
References section complete; all citations verified

GATE_3_evidence_and_accuracy.text: All statistics traced to verifiable, current published sources
All named researchers and quoted findings are real and accurately attributed
All case examples framed as fictional composites or appropriately sourced
All crisis resource contacts verified active and regionally accurate at generation date
All Amazon competitor page-count data is current, not carried forward
Trademark search date and databases recorded; status rationale documented
APA 7 (or selected style) applied consistently across in-text citations and reference list
No outdated laws, guidelines, or statistics presented as current

GATE_4_production_and_uniqueness.text: Page count falls within the competitor-informed target range
All images generated and inserted, or complete fallback prompts placed at exact insertion points with placement, caption, alt text
No image violates visual safety rules (no graphic distress, before/after body comparison, instant-healing imagery, or unauthorized real person)
Chapter architecture, opening patterns, exercise sequence, example set, and image arrangement demonstrably distinct from any prior UAPF self-help title
Anti-AI language protocol applied; no prohibited filler terms present as defaults
Voice calibration consistent with assigned risk tier throughout
Times New Roman throughout, correct heading styles, live TOC field populated/updateable, page numbers correct, no orphaned headings or clipped tables/images
Final document rendered page by page and visually inspected before delivery
